Olivia (AE): Quick: customer requires BYOK with CloudHSM, FIPS140-2 L3, and explicit no-key-escrow unless contractually approved. Need POC checklist + pricing bullets for procurement.
Arun (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a lean POC: create CMK in their AWS account, grant Redwood role, run encrypt/decrypt, perform alias rotation, measure p95/p99.
Marta (Security): Must include: CloudTrail forwarding to their log account, KMS key policy with explicit Deny for ScheduleKeyDeletion, and Condition on aws:SourceVpc if possible.
Ben (SRE): Network needs: VPC peering or Transit GW, route tables, and an assumable IAM role ARN. If they insist key material never leaves their account we must use Redwood Private in their VPC.
Olivia (AE): Procurement wants to know if HSM-backed CMKs create a monthly fee or just pass-through.
Ben (SRE): Short answer: CloudHSM in their account is billed to them; we add a one-time integration SOW and a recurring Private ops fee when we host Private. Hosted managed keys have no per-CMK pass-through.
Arun (Solutions Eng): Sample minimal key policy snippet to share (they should edit ARNs):
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:SourceAccount":"123456789012"}}}]}
Marta (Security): Also add an explicit control: alert on repeated kms:Decrypt failures and require retention of KMS CloudTrail events for 90 days (adjustable). For escrow: we DO NOT hold key material unless SOWed; include that language.
Olivia (AE): Timeline: customer asks for kickoff in 2 weeks. What's realistic to get a POC + pricing stub?
Ben (SRE): If we get IAM role + peering details by next Tue: POC environment in 7-10 business days. Private+HSM full integration: 4-6 weeks. On-prem HSM: add vendor lead time.
finance-bot: Created ticket FIN-9021: "Estimate: CloudHSM pass-through + integration SOW + Private ops fee".
Arun (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble the one-page POC runbook and test payloads. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Marta (Security): I'll prepare questionnaire answers and flag anything needing legal.
Olivia (AE): Great—I'll send the kickoff invite after we post the pack to this thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
